messages:
nina: noticed console route breakdown shows two entries for the same customer route: "billing" and "Billing" after yesterday's ts-sdk 0.11.0 rollout. quotas look split.

paul: interesting, we normalise route ids in the policy service to lowercase. Could be an SDK-side change submitting route hints with original casing.

yvonne: confirm, ts-sdk 0.11.0 added an auto-normalizer in the client that tries to preserve user-provided case by default (to avoid surprising UI rewrites). That means requests now send header Route-Name: Billing instead of billing.

nina: console's quota aggregation keys are case-sensitive right now, so metrics and quota buckets split. Customer reported unexpected quota exhaustion.

paul: short-term: we can make console & quota-lookup do case-insensitive match and prefer the canonical lowercased route if conflict. Low-risk patch.

yvonne: SDK revert idea: ship 0.11.1 that stops preserving case and always lowercases route hint when writing header. But that's a breaking behavioral change if some users rely on case.

nina: which customers are impacted? I checked the tenant and it's a few SMBs with route names created in console using capitalized names. They expect quotas to apply.

paul: ops proposal: console patch to canonicalize during resolution (owner: paul). SDK patch as opt-in flag `preserve_route_case=true` for users who need it (owner: yvonne). Then update docs and add a migration banner in Console showing routes with casing conflicts.

yvonne: I can prepare a patch for ts 0.11.1 and python 0.11.1 within the hour. We'll keep default legacy behavior as lowercase to be safe, and the opt-in flag flips new behavior.

nina: also add a short-term admin UI that lists conflicting route keys (Billing vs billing) so customer success can merge them manually. I'll file the UI ticket.

infra-bot: deploy started: canary/route-case-tolerant -> prod-1 (sha: f7a8b9c)

paul: I'll add a console heuristic: when both casings exist and one has >80% traffic, map the other to it for quota lookups for 7 days, then show recommended merge.

yvonne: will include tests for header casing and roundtrip in SDK unit suite.

nina: owners recap: paul (console resolution + heuristic), yvonne (sdk patch + opt-in flag), nina (UI ticket + CS note). We'll monitor quota attribution for 72h. Ping here for rollouts. :thumbsup:
